notes.title: Kinetic Canvas v1.3 update - COLOUR SCHEMES!
notes.content:
Hello lovely people!

I've added a few new things to customize the colours, plus some small things to help people making screenshots and videos.

[b]New features:[/b]
1. New options to change tint hue colour and intensity.  Reduce the intensity to zero to return to multi-colour.
2. New option to change background brightness.

[b]Changes & improvements:[/b]
1. Removed option to mute music, you now change via music volume.
2. PC & Mac - New [b]"U"[/b] key toggle, to hide cursor & UI completely (for screen capture e.g. videos/screenshots)
3. Can now draw over the top-right area without triggering the options menu to open

Hope you enjoy!

Cheers,
Chris aka Sonicfactory

notes.title: Kinetic Canvas v1.2 Update
notes.content:
Hi people! 

I made a few tweaks to make Kinetic Canvas more beautiful.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502782/188114fc57241a13909968808f58905b41024773.png[/img]

Please check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3429759522]keyboard, mouse and gamepad controls[/url] guide - e.g. pressing [b]Space[/b] on PC allows you to pause everything, and copying screenshot to clipboard by pressing [b]Alt+Enter[/b].

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
1. Added more randomization to the sparkles
2. Improved colour scheme and vibrancy
3. Added pulsing to the trails

[h2]Small bugfixes:[/h2]
1. Fixed an erroneous texture

notes.title: Kinetic Canvas v1.1 Update
notes.content:
Hi people! 

I made a few tweaks to make Kinetic Canvas more beautiful.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502782/ccdf8b368f14cd25e7dbc36e73f9a814725d886c.png[/img]

The most noticeable thing is the "mirror" mode which you can tick on in the options menu, which can help you create more symmetrical images.

Please check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3429759522]keyboard, mouse and gamepad controls[/url] guide - e.g. pressing [b]Space[/b] on PC allows you to pause everything, and copying screenshot to clipboard by pressing [b]Alt+Enter[/b].

[h2]New features & improvements to visuals:[/h2]
1. New "mirror" mode added to the options menu, which enables a reflection of your drawing.
2. Updates to color balance to avoid white glare / overload of white.
3. More vivid color balances.
4. Introduced smoke-like "light trails" on, with better color, clarity and less noise.
5. Replaced one texture that was [strike]really crap[/strike] adversely affecting the experience.

[h2]Small bugfixes:[/h2]
1. Hopefully resolved crash in the donation panel for iOS, when opening the app after device wakes from sleep.
